newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NBS LIFTS S.AFRICAN PRIME RATE ONE POINT.
newsitem.headline: NBS LIFTS S.AFRICAN PRIME RATE ONE POINT.

text.p: NBS Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was following the lead of three of the country's four leading banks by increasing its prime overdraft rate to 20.25 percent from 19.25 percent with immediate effect.
The home loan loan will go up by the same amount to 20.00 percent from November 25, a company spokesman said.
Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd , Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd and Nedcor Ltd all announced one point rate hikes earlier, following a similar increase in the official Bank rate.
First National Bank Holdings Ltd -- the last of the "big four" -- is expected to follow suit shortly.
